belt-knots.step-1: Lay the belt flat in front of you with the front side facing up.
belt-knots.step-2: Fold the long end over the short end.
belt-knots.step-3: Pass the long end through the loop from underneath.
belt-knots.step-4: Tighten the knot by pulling on both ends.
belt-knots.step-5: Check that the knot looks neat and symmetrical.
belt-knots.tip-1: Make sure the belt is not too tight, but still secure.
belt-knots.tip-2: The ends should be the same length after knotting.
belt-knots.tip-3: Practice several times to get a neat, tight knot.
belt-knots.tip-4: For advanced judoka: the double knot is faster and more secure.
